title: Accounts Receivable Officer
description:
Accounts Receivable Officer / Sales Ledger

Doncaster £30,000 - £35,000 per annum (pro rata for part-time hours)

Full-time or part-time considered - flexible working arrangements available

An excellent opportunity has arisen for an experienced Accounts Receivable/Sales Ledger professional to join a well-established and growing organisation based in Doncaster.

This is an opportunity to join a small, collaborative finance team in a role where you can genuinely make a difference. The business is currently investing in its finance and billing systems, making this an interesting time to join and contribute to improving processes, accuracy and overall efficiency.

Working closely with the Accounts Receivable Manager and wider finance team, you will take responsibility for maintaining an accurate sales ledger, ensuring invoices are raised correctly, payments are allocated appropriately and outstanding debt is actively managed.

The Job:
- Preparing and issuing accurate sales invoices and authorised credit notes.
- Maintaining accurate customer accounts, fee records and funding information.
- Allocating incoming payments and investigating unallocated cash and discrepancies.
- Monitoring aged debt and proactively following up outstanding payments.
- Liaising with local authorities, commissioners, funding bodies and internal teams to resolve queries.
- Reconciling customer accounts and supporting sales ledger and bank receipt reconciliations.
- Investigating billing discrepancies, short payments and overdue balances.
- Supporting month-end reporting and maintaining accurate financial records.
- Assisting with the implementation and testing of a new billing system.
- Other ad hoc duties as required.

The Person:
- The success candidate will have have previous experience in accounts receivable, sales ledger, credit control or a similar transactional finance position.
- You need a good understanding of invoicing, cash allocation, reconciliations and aged debt, alongside strong Excel skills and confidence using accounting systems.
- You will be organised, proactive and comfortable investigating issues rather than simply processing transactions.
- You will enjoy working with different people, communicating professionally with external organisations and taking ownership of your workload.

title: Call Centre Agent
description:
Sales Advisors

If you're outgoing, full of energy and love talking to people, you'd be better off in sales with EE.

Maybe you've worked in retail, or hospitality before. You know how to deal with customers but you're looking for something more exciting - a job that's going to challenge you. And, of course, you want to earn a bit more cash.

Our Doncaster team's full of people like you - so you'll be in great company here.

What does being a sales advisor involve?

You'll join a lively sales team in our Doncaster contact centre. We'll train you to take incoming calls from existing EE customers and help them find the best deals on their phones and broadband. You'll also help them to navigate the different tech products we sell.

You need to be a great listener as well as a fluent talker. A lot of the time, you'll pick up on something that someone has said, then use that to match them with the perfect product.

Forget what you've heard about sales

Don't let what you've heard about sales put you off. Let's smash a few myths
- Yes, there are targets to hit. But the kind of people who like sales, love that. You're probably naturally competitive. You get a buzz out of beating the person next to you. You hate being bored at work.
- It's not "cold calling". The calls come in to you and you decide how best you can help the customer. That's why we value resourceful people who like fixing problems.
- People say it's "hard selling". It's really not! You're basically talking to people about fun tech stuff that they already want. Who doesn't love a better phone, faster broadband or a new console?

Why you'll be better off at EE

GREAT MONEY - you start on £26,116 which goes up to £26,738 after 8 months.

UNCAPPED COMMISSION - the more you sell, the more you can earn.

BRILLIANT BENEFITS - including 24/7 GP appointments for you and your family, free parking and discounts on EE products like phones and broadband that could save you £100s every year.

GROWTH - we're passionate about developing our people. There are plenty of career paths across EE and BT.

FLEXIBILITY - you can bank hours then take time off when you need. Plus, generous leave for carers and anyone starting a family.

GREAT PEOPLE - you're working with people like you. It's a sociable, supportive environment.

title: Central Transport Purchasing Administrator
description:
Location: ReFood, Doncaster

REFOOD

Business: The ReFood AD plants operate as integrated recycling units, processing a variety of food wastes to produce biogas, renewable electricity, heat and ReGrow (a nutrient-rich fertiliser for local farms). The plants also recycle the food waste packaging providing an environmentally sustainable solution for all waste producers looking for a safe method of diverting food waste from landfill.

The Position

Applications are invited for a Central Transport Purchasing Administrator based at our Doncaster site. This is a full time, permanent, position working 40 hours per week.

As a Central Transport Purchasing Administrator, your duties and responsibilities will vary on the Company's requirements but will include the following:
- Act as the central administrator for all transport purchase orders across the Doncaster, Widnes and Dagenham sites.
- Raise purchase quotes promptly using the information and supporting documentation provided by the relevant Transport Manager or requester.
- Ensure purchase order information is entered accurately, with particular attention to supplier details, dates, cost centres, values and other required system information.
- Monitor purchase quotes through the internal approval process and follow up with approvers where necessary to prevent avoidable delays.
- Convert approved purchase quotes into purchase orders and issue the completed purchase orders to suppliers.
- Monitor purchase orders through to completion, maintaining accurate and up-to-date records within the internal purchase order system.
- Obtain confirmation from the requester or relevant site contact that goods have been received or services completed before receipting the purchase order within the system for payment.
- Assist the Group Purchasing team and Finance with the investigation and resolution of transport-related purchase order queries, including obtaining missing information from the relevant site.
- Obtain the necessary supplier information, complete new vendor setup forms accurately and submit them to the central team for approval and processing.
- Liaise effectively with Transport Managers, site teams, Group Purchasing, Finance, internal approvers and approved suppliers in relation to purchase order administration.
- Undertake any other reasonable administrative duties as required, commensurate with the level of the role.

The Person
- Strong previous experience within an administrative role.
- Previous experience using a purchase order or purchasing system, including raising, monitoring or receipting purchase orders.
- Able to work independently whilst contributing positively to a wider team across multiple sites.
- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accurate data entry.
- Good IT skills, including Microsoft Office and Excel, together with the ability to learn and confidently use the company's internal purchase order system.

Salary: Competitive Salary plus Company Benefits

Please note that only shortlisted applicants will be contacted due to the high volume of CV's being received.

title: Logistics Coordinator
description:
Our client is a well-established and successful manufacturer. They are looking for a Logistics Coordinator to co-ordinate new equipment projects for national and international shipping to customers.

Salary: £15.00 per hour + Overtime

NOTE: This is a temporary contract for 3 to 6 months (there may be a chance to go permanent, but not guaranteed)

PLEASE ONLY APPLY IF YOU MEET THE MAJORITY OF THE FOLLOWING REQUIREMENTS:
- A minimum of 3 years Logistics experience is essential, along with some experience in Supply Chain.
- You have experience of using a Counterbalance FLT, and have an in-date Counterbalance Forklift Truck license.
- You are fully conversant with Microsoft applications, particularly Dynamics 365, OneNote and Excel.
- Flexibility to work within a fast-paced environment with changing priorities.
- Great communication skills, especially with teamwork.
- Time management, organisation, and prioritising skills.

Responsibilities:

The role will involve the aftermarket sales shipment handling with the Aftermarket Sales Co-Ordinator for preparation, documentation and transactional requirements in the system. The Logistics Co-ordinator role encompasses all elements of customer shipments including internal discussions, product expediting, supplier co-ordination for packing and loading, consumable management, all required documentation and organisation/communication with shipping agents. In parallel with general tasks, there is also a necessity to be involved with improvement projects for the Supply Chain team and Logistics functions.
- Facilitate the shipping of projects from one destination to another.
- Co-ordinating and taking part in the loading of shipments with fork lift truck drivers.
- Load preparation with Forklift Truck Drivers.
- Operate a Counterbalance Fork Lift Truck (with fork extensions).
- Orchestrate deliveries to meet customer demand to an internal on time in full delivery target.
- Liaising and management of packing and crating requirements, internal and external communication.
- Organising shipment collections.
- Internal communications for shipment of projects such as Production, Finance and any other department supporting the shipping process.
- Administrative requirements in the system including photographs and the use of Infor XA, OneNote and Microsoft applications (e.g. Excel and Dynamics 365).
- Creation and maintenance of project folders for Logistics information.
- Storage of projects prior to shipment and optimisation of space/capacity.
- Consumable management for Logistics requirements.
- New equipment identification tagging and checks.
- Creation of documents for use on project content checks and shipment inclusive of packing lists and commercial invoice.
- Take steps to avoid additional shipment of project content (i.e. missed items in the original shipment).
- Documenting shipment information such as photographs and paperwork per project.
- Volumetric analysis and expectations for shipment requirements i.e. container volume per project.
- Process reviews to streamline the shipping and transportation processes.
- Documentation and customer communication for Aftermarket sales orders.
- Shipment bookings for Aftermarket sales orders.
- Checks and compliance to the required country legislation for all documentation projects and Aftermarket sales orders.
- Purchase orders and transactions within Infor XA and AS400 in a timely manner for projects and Aftermarket sales orders.
- Any other task that is required to fulfil the duties within the Logistics and Supply Chain function.

This role would suit someone with experience in a similar role, such as; Logistics Planner / Dispatch Planner / Despatch Coordinator / Supply Chain Coordinator / Operations Coordinator / Transport Coordinator / Operations Scheduler / Logistics Specialist / Shipping Clerk / Export Coordinator / Shipping Coordinator / Fleet Coordinator / Logistics Supervisor / Logistics Manager / Export Coordinator

title: Paralegal
description:
Paralegal - Commercial Property

Location: Doncaster
Salary: £25,000 - £32,000 DOE
Job Type: Full Time, Permanent

Join a Growing Commercial Property Team

We are currently recruiting for a Paralegal to join a busy and well-established Commercial Property team in Doncaster. This is an excellent opportunity for an ambitious legal professional looking to develop their career within commercial real estate, working alongside experienced solicitors on a varied and interesting caseload.

This role would suit an experienced Paralegal, Legal Assistant, or Law Graduate with previous property law experience who is looking to gain exposure to high-quality commercial property matters.

- Assisting fee earners with a broad range of commercial property transactions.
- Preparing legal documents, contracts, leases, licences, and reports.
- Conducting Land Registry and Companies House searches.
- Managing files from instruction through to completion.
- Liaising with clients, solicitors, local authorities, lenders, and other third parties.
- Handling post-completion matters and file administration.
- Maintaining accurate case records and ensuring compliance requirements are met.
- Supporting the team with property acquisitions, disposals, lease renewals, and landlord & tenant matters.

What We're Looking For
- Previous experience within a legal environment, ideally Commercial Property.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines effectively.
- Proficient IT skills and experience using case management systems.
- A proactive and professional approach to client service.

What's on Offer
- Competitive salary dependent on experience.
- Opportunity to work alongside experienced Commercial Property specialists.
- Ongoing training and career development.
- Supportive and collaborative working environment.
- Long-term career progression opportunities.

If you're looking to take the next step in your legal career and gain valuable experience within a thriving Commercial Property department, we'd love to hear from you.

To apply, please submit your CV today for a confidential discussion.

title: Part-time Payroll Admin
description:
Portfolio Payroll are recruiting on behalf of our client, a well-established and growing manufacturing business, who are looking to appoint an experienced Part-Time Payroll Administrator to join their friendly finance team.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a payroll professional seeking flexibility whilst working within a supportive and stable environment.

The Role

Reporting into the Finance Manager, you will take ownership of the payroll function, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time. You will be responsible for managing the end-to-end payroll process using Sage Payroll and acting as a key point of contact for payroll-related queries.

Key Responsibilities

- Maintaining employee payroll records and ensuring data accuracy
- Processing starters, leavers, salary changes and statutory payments
- Managing SSP, SMP, SPP and other payroll-related calculations
- Submitting RTI reports to HMRC
- Processing pension contributions and handling auto-enrolment requirements
- Reconciling payroll reports and resolving payroll discrepancies
- Responding to employee payroll and pension queries
- Ensuring compliance with payroll legislation and company policies

About You
- Previous payroll experience within a standalone or payroll administration role
- Confident processing end-to-end payroll
- Experience using Sage Payroll is essential
- Strong understanding of HMRC legislation, RTI and statutory payments
- Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
- Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team

What's On Offer?
- Salary up to £30,000 FTE
- Flexible part-time hours
- Supportive and friendly working environment
- Stable and successful manufacturing business
- Opportunity to take ownership of the payroll function
